value.rationale: The motivating primary article explicitly leaves the first nontrivial generalized-family critical equality (k=2) unresolved: its sign cannot be inferred from either strict side. The beta coefficient resolves that exact boundary and determines how an unstable cycle is born, with an unusual 1/14 amplitude exponent, explicit constant and physical clock. These are structurally relevant to nilpotent center-focus degeneracy and bifurcation, not merely a routine renaming, recomputation of a known table or unsupported tiny numerical improvement.
